row:
Rebel Animal Rescue is a Texas Panhandle nonprofit pulling dogs and cats from local kill shelters and urgent situations.
We care for them in our rescue shop with 7 dog kennels and 10 cat areas, plus a small but dedicated network of foster homes—until they’re ready for adoption.

🐾 Want to help save lives?
➡️ Donate or shop our wishlists: https://www.rebelanimalrescue.org/support

➡️ Foster, adopt, or volunteer to make a direct impact.

Real rescue. Real stories. Real second chances.
